setup: The polynomial is \(P(x) = [[poly]]\), with constant term [[a0]] and leading coefficient [[a4]].

steps.say: The reciprocal polynomial reverses the coefficients, so the constant term of \(Q\) is the leading coefficient [[a4]].
By Vieta, the sum of the reciprocals of the roots is \(-a_1/a_0 = [[sum_reciprocals]]\).
Because the degree is even, the product of the reciprocals is \(a_4/a_0 = [[product_reciprocals]]\).
